Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.social

Class SocialConfiguration

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.social.SocialConfiguration
@Configuration(value="socialWebConfiguration", proxyBeanMethods=false) @Conditional(SocialProvidersCondition.class) @EnableConfigurationProperties(SocialProperties.class) public class SocialConfiguration extends Object
Installs the sign-in with external providers in the login/UI chain. Nothing outside this feature is edited: the chain applies every LoginChainCustomizer bean, in order, before its catch-all rule. All of it hangs from SocialProvidersCondition: with no provider configured there is no bean here at all, so the application behaves exactly as it does without the feature.

      @Bean public FederatedAccountResolver federatedAccountResolver(ResolveFederatedLoginUseCase useCase, org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.UserDetailsService userDetailsService, LinkIdentityUseCase linkIdentityUseCase, PendingIdentityLinks pendingIdentityLinks)
      Declares the resolver of the local account of a sign-in, with the account status rules of the other sign-in methods.

      userDetailsService - loads the accounts.

    • socialChainCustomizer

      @Bean @Order(5) public LoginChainCustomizer socialChainCustomizer(org.springframework.security.oauth2.client.registration.ClientRegistrationRepository repository, FederatedOidcUserService oidcService, FederatedOAuth2UserService oauth2Service, FactorGrantor grantor, FederatedFactorSelector selector, org.springframework.beans.factory.ObjectProvider<AppleClientSecretGenerator> apple, PendingIdentityLinks pendingIdentityLinks)
      Declares the customizer that enables http.oauth2Login(...). It is applied after the phone page one.
      Parameters:
      repository - registrations of the configured providers.
      oidcService - user service of the OpenID Connect providers.
      oauth2Service - user service of the OAuth 2.0 providers.
      grantor - adds the factor authority.
      selector - chooses the factor.
      apple - generates the Apple client secret; absent while Apple is not configured.
      pendingIdentityLinks - the link markers, which tell a link apart from a sign-in.
      Returns:
      the customizer.
